title: Name Tag
story: Chilaka needs a name tag and a lives counter. Variables are labelled boxes that remember things.
goal: Create name = "Chilaka" and lives = 3, then print: Chilaka has 3 lives (use the variables).
starter:
# 1. make a variable called name
# 2. make a variable called lives
# 3. print the sentence using both variables
hints: A variable is a labelled box: name = "Chilaka" puts text in a box called name.
Make both variables first. Then give print() the variable names themselves, without quotes around them.
socratic: What is the difference between name and "name"?
How can print() show several things on one line?
Did you create both variables before printing?
explain: In one sentence: why use a variable instead of typing the text again?

example.title: Worked example: a snack bill
example.note: Name a value with =, then print the name (without quotes) to show what it holds.
